description: This file contains code for registering and managing a service worker in a web application, including functions for registration, validation, and unregistration, as well as configuration types and environment checks.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Main function to register the service worker if conditions are met, including environment and hostname checks.

methods.name: registerValidSW
methods.description: Registers the service worker and sets up update handling and callbacks.

methods.name: checkValidServiceWorker
methods.description: Checks if the service worker script exists and is valid, otherwise reloads the page.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the service worker if registered.
